chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and Muhammad ibn Abdillah both narrated to me from Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: Indeed, the Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equals a purified and accepted 'Umrah.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the profound spiritual status of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.) by equating his visitation to an accepted 'Umrah, a comparison that elevates Ziyarah from a mere act of remembrance to a complete ritual of worship. In Shia scholarly tradition, this equivalence highlights the unique intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt and the transformative power of visiting their shrines, particularly Karbala, as a means of attaining divine acceptance and forgiveness.
